summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group reporting the results of its 21st Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 26, 2026, where shareholders approved a year-end cash dividend of ¥51 per share and elected 15 directors. It contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return event, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. As a routine meeting results report, it does not qualify as a special-situation filing.
